entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-15
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Lifted GroupBy element projection splits groups that differ only by collation #39241
    12.0-preview1
  • Overloaded HasDbFunction throws NullReferenceException in ConcreteColumnExpression constructor #33542
    12.0-preview1
  • Create AggregateFunctionExpression #38357
    12.0-preview1
  • Scaffolding drops view-level comments #39264
    12.0-preview1
  • Support native SQL Server MERGE statement inside SaveChanges batching #39235
  • Vulnerable transitive System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs dependency introduced by Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer #39252
    10.0.16
  • FirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning is not logged for First/FirstOrDefault on a collection navigation in a subquery #39129
    12.0-preview1
  • Regression in 10.0: correlated SelectMany + DefaultIfEmpty over a GroupBy subquery is translated to OUTER APPLY instead of LEFT JOIN #39220
    11.0.0
  • Precompiled query throws InvalidCastException materializing a property whose value converter is a ValueConverter subclass #39174
    12.0-preview1
  • RevEng: Improve error message when not supported #14629
    12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Collection with conversion to primitive collection throws #31616
    Backlog
  • Support IDictionary navigation property for one-to-many relationship #21262
    Backlog
  • Allow moving an entity between collections without deleting its children #30634
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix select concat #39269
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39268
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 9.0.20 to 9.0.21 #39267
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #39266

Merged

  • Identify lifted GroupBy groupings by a database-computed rank #39242
    community-contribution
  • Differentiate overloaded functions and stored procedures in TableMappingBaseComparer #39211
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Add AggregateFunctionExpression as a relational base for provider aggregate functions #39234
    community-contribution, api-review
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39259
  • Preserve view comments during scaffolding #39265
  • Log FirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning for First on a collection navigation in a subquery #39218
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Update System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs to 10.0.13 #39263
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39260
  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0 #39250
  • Cast to the closed ValueConverter<,> in the precompiled shaper #39236
    community-contribution
  • Convert unsigned enums to decimal through their underlying type #39228
    community-contribution
  • Improve error message when provider does not support reverse engineering #39209
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Make the evals more realistic and improve the skills accordingly #39217
    area-harness
  • Add experimental ExecuteMerge / upsert support #39100
    community-contribution
